def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Split into two equal panels at the full monochrome separator.
    for r in range(h):
        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and r > 0 and h-r-1 == r:
            top, bottom = grid[:r], grid[r+1:]
            sep = grid[r][0]
            shared = (set(x for row in top for x in row) &
                      set(x for row in bottom for x in row)) - {sep}
            if len(shared) == 1:
                base = next(iter(shared))
                return [[3 if top[y][x] == bottom[y][x] else base
                         for x in range(w)] for y in range(r)]
    for c in range(w):
        if all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid) and c > 0 and w-c-1 == c:
            left = [row[:c] for row in grid]
            right = [row[c+1:] for row in grid]
            sep = grid[0][c]
            shared = (set(x for row in left for x in row) &
                      set(x for row in right for x in row)) - {sep}
            if len(shared) == 1:
                base = next(iter(shared))
                return [[3 if left[y][x] == right[y][x] else base
                         for x in range(c)] for y in range(h)]
    return grid
PY
